# Position Search Process FAQ

<!-- This page is auto-generated from the field FAQ knowledge base, 5 entries -->

## Q1: After a successful position search, the new position is not stored in the set point variable

Change the position search type in the position search parameters from reference position search to correction position search

## Q2: Megmeet welder arc position search, after finding the point it moves in reverse

The position search polarity is not enabled

## Q3: After arc position search reaches the workpiece, there is no spark and no return

1. Check whether the welder has a position search function, or whether the welder parameters are set accurately. 2. Check whether the return distance is set.

## Q4: Arc position search is inaccurate

Perform single-point position search; if inaccurate, check the TCP.

## Q5: When using two-point simple touch position search, the found point is incorrect.

When using two-point simple touch position search, "change posture" needs to be enabled in the tracking position search process parameter settings
